responses: Top attractions in Kathmandu include Swayambhunath Stupa (Monkey Temple), Pashupatinath Temple, Boudhanath Stupa, Kathmandu Durbar Square, Garden of Dreams, and the vibrant Thamel district.

responses: Must-try food in Kathmandu includes Newari cuisine, Momo (dumplings), Dal Bhat, Samay Baji, Yomari, and Chatamari. Visit Thamel for great restaurants!

patterns: how do I get to Kathmandu
responses: Kathmandu is accessible by international flights to Tribhuvan International Airport, and by bus from major cities in Nepal. Local transport includes taxis, buses, and rickshaws.
Best shopping in Kathmandu includes Thamel for trekking gear, Pashmina, handicrafts, singing bowls, and Thanka paintings. Durbar Square also has great local crafts.
Pokhara is Nepal's second-largest city and the gateway to the Annapurna region. Known for its stunning lakes, mountain views, and adventure activities like paragliding.

patterns: what are the top attractions in Pokhara
responses: Top attractions in Pokhara include Phewa Lake, Sarangkot viewpoint, World Peace Pagoda, Davis Falls, Gupteshwor Cave, and Begnas Lake. Don't miss paragliding!

patterns: what are the best hotels in Pokhara
responses: Best hotels in Pokhara include Temple Tree Resort & Spa, Hotel Pokhara Grande, and budget options like Hotel Orchid and Zostel Pokhara near Lakeside.
Must-try food in Pokhara includes Momo, Dal Bhat, fresh fish from Phewa Lake, Sel Roti, and Thakali Set. Lakeside has many great restaurants!
Pokhara is accessible by bus from Kathmandu (6-7 hours) or by flight (25 minutes). Local transport includes taxis, auto-rickshaws, and rental bikes/scooters.
Best shopping in Pokhara includes Lakeside for Pashmina, handicrafts, trekking gear, local art, singing bowls, and Buddhist art.
Lumbini is the birthplace of Lord Buddha, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. It's one of the most sacred pilgrimage sites in the world with beautiful monasteries and gardens.
Top attractions in Lumbini include Maya Devi Temple, Sacred Garden, Ashoka Pillar, Chinese Monastery, Japanese Monastery, Lumbini Museum, and World Peace Pagoda.
Best hotels in Lumbini include Lumbini Garden Hotel, Hotel Lumbini Hokke, Lumbini Buddha Garden, and budget options like Ananda Inn and Korea Guest House.
Must-try food in Lumbini includes local Nepali and Buddhist cuisine, Dal Bhat, Momo, Thukpa, Tibetan Bread, and Local Thali.
Lumbini is accessible by flights to Bhairahawa Airport from Kathmandu (35 minutes), or by bus (8-10 hours). Local transport includes taxis, auto-rickshaws, and bicycles.
Chitwan is famous for Chitwan National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. It's Nepal's premier wildlife destination with one-horned rhinos, Bengal tigers, and over 500 bird species.
Top attractions in Chitwan include Chitwan National Park, Jungle Safari (Jeep or elephant), Elephant Breeding Center, Tharu Cultural Museum, Canoe Ride, and Elephant Bathing.
Best hotels in Chitwan include Tiger Tops Tharu Lodge, Hotel Jungle Crown, Green Park Chitwan, and budget options like Jungle Villa Resort and Hotel Parkside.
Must-try food in Chitwan includes Tharu cuisine (Ghugni, Bara, Dhikri), Dal Bhat, Momo, fresh river fish, and local vegetables.
Chitwan is accessible by flights to Bharatpur Airport from Kathmandu (25 minutes), or by bus (5-6 hours). Local transport includes taxis, auto-rickshaws, and rental bikes.
Bhaktapur is known for its well-preserved medieval architecture and is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. It's called the 'City of Devotees' with rich Newari culture.
Top attractions in Bhaktapur include Bhaktapur Durbar Square, Nyatapola Temple (tallest pagoda in Nepal), 55-Window Palace, Pottery Square, and Dattatreya Square.
Best hotels in Bhaktapur include Heritage Hotel Bhaktapur, Hotel Nagarkot, and budget options like Bhaktapur Guest House and Shiva Guest House.
Must-try food in Bhaktapur includes Jhol Momo (soup dumplings), Yomri (sweet dumpling), Chatamari (Newari pizza), Sel Roti, and Bara (lentil pancake).
Bhaktapur is accessible by bus from Kathmandu (1 hour) or taxi (45 minutes). Local transport includes walking, taxis, and rickshaws.
Best shopping in Bhaktapur includes Pottery Square for ceramics, wood carvings, handicrafts, and traditional masks at Durbar Square.
Lalitpur (Patan) is one of the three royal cities in Kathmandu Valley, renowned for its exquisite Newari architecture and UNESCO World Heritage Sites.
Top attractions in Lalitpur include Patan Durbar Square, Krishna Mandir, Golden Temple, Patan Museum, and Kumbheswor Temple.
Best hotels in Lalitpur include Patan Courtyard Hotel, Hotel Patan, and budget options like Patan Guest House and Newa Chhen.
Must-try food in Lalitpur includes Newari Khaja, Chhwela (spiced meat), Bara, Yomri, and Samay Baji (traditional Newari meal).
Lalitpur is accessible by bus from Kathmandu (30 minutes) or taxi (20 minutes). Local transport includes walking, taxis, and rickshaws.
Best shopping in Lalitpur includes metal crafts, wood carvings, handicrafts, and Thanka paintings at Durbar Square.
The Everest Region is home to the world's highest peak, Mount Everest (Sagarmatha at 8,848.86m), and offers world-class trekking with stunning mountain scenery.
Top attractions in Everest Region include Namche Bazaar, Tengboche Monastery, Kala Patthar viewpoint, and the legendary Everest Base Camp trek.

patterns: Where to stay in Everest Region
responses: Best hotels in Everest Region include Yeti Mountain Home in Lukla, Hotel Everest View in Namche Bazaar, and tea houses throughout the trek.

patterns: What to eat in Everest Region
responses: Must-try food in Everest Region includes Dal Bhat, Momo, Thukpa, Tsampa (roasted barley), and Tibetan Bread.

patterns: How to go to Everest Region
responses: Everest Region is accessible by flight to Lukla from Kathmandu (30 minutes), or helicopter (NPR 50,000+). Local transport is mostly walking/trekking.
The Annapurna Region offers some of the world's best trekking including the famous Annapurna Circuit and Annapurna Base Camp trek, with stunning mountain views.

patterns: What to see in Annapurna Region
responses: Top attractions in Annapurna Region include Poon Hill sunrise, Annapurna Base Camp, Annapurna Circuit, Ghandruk village, and Machhapuchhre Base Camp.

patterns: Where to stay in Annapurna Region
responses: Best hotels in Annapurna Region include Annapurna Eco Lodge in Ghandruk, Mountain View Lodge in Ghorepani, and tea houses throughout the trek.

patterns: What to eat in Annapurna Region
responses: Must-try food in Annapurna Region includes Dal Bhat, Momo, Thukpa, Tibetan Bread, and Sherpa stew.
Annapurna Region is accessible by bus from Pokhara to Besishahar or Naya Pul, then walking/trekking. Jeep transport is available for road sections.
Mustang is a former kingdom of Nepal with unique Tibetan Buddhist culture, ancient monasteries, and dramatic desert-like landscapes. It's a restricted area requiring special permits.
Top attractions in Mustang include Lo Manthang (walled city), Muktinath Temple, Kali Gandaki Gorge (world's deepest gorge), and Jomsom.
Best hotels in Mustang include Hotel Annapurna Mustang in Jomsom, Mustang Eco Lodge in Lo Manthang, and tea houses throughout the region.
Must-try food in Mustang includes Dal Bhat, Momo, Thukpa, Tsampa, Apple Brandy, and Dried Apples.
Mustang is accessible by flight to Jomsom from Kathmandu (30 minutes), or by road via Beni. Local transport includes walking/trekking and jeeps.
Manang is a high-altitude Himalayan district in the Annapurna region, known for stunning landscapes, Tilicho Lake (one of the highest lakes in the world), and Tibetan Buddhist culture.
Top attractions in Manang include Tilicho Lake (4,919m), Braga Monastery, Gangapurna Lake, Manang Village, and Ice Lake.
Best hotels in Manang include Manang Eco Resort, Hotel Manang, and tea houses throughout the Annapurna Circuit.
Must-try food in Manang includes Dal Bhat, Momo, Thukpa, Tsampa, and Tibetan Bread.
Manang is accessible by road from Kathmandu via Besishahar, then trekking or jeep to Chame and Manang.
Janakpur is the birthplace of Goddess Sita and one of Nepal's most important pilgrimage sites, known for the magnificent Janaki Mandir and Mithila art.
Top attractions in Janakpur include Janaki Mandir, Ram Sita Vivaha Mandap, Gangasagar Pond, and Mithila Art Museum.
Best hotels in Janakpur include Hotel Sita Palace, Hotel Janakpur Inn, and budget options like Janakpur Guest House and Hotel Welcome.
Must-try food in Janakpur includes Dal Bhat, Momo, Maithili cuisine, Tarua (fried vegetables), and local sweets.
Janakpur is accessible by flight from Kathmandu (30 minutes) or by bus (8-10 hours). Local transport includes tempo, rickshaw, and taxi.
Gorkha is the birthplace of King Prithvi Narayan Shah who unified Nepal. It's known for Gorkha Durbar, a historic palace with stunning views of the Himalayas.
Top attractions in Gorkha include Gorkha Durbar, Gorkha Nath Temple, and Gorkha Museum showcasing military history.
Best hotels in Gorkha include Gorkha Garden Hotel, Hotel Gorkha, and budget options like Gorkha Guest House and New Gorkha Hotel.
Must-try food in Gorkha includes Dal Bhat, Momo, local Nepali dishes, and Thakali Set.
Gorkha is accessible by bus from Kathmandu (6-7 hours) or taxi (5 hours). Local transport includes walking and taxis.
Syangja is a beautiful hill district in Gandaki Province, famous for the Manakamana Temple and authentic Gurung culture in Sirubari village.
Top attractions in Syangja include Manakamana Temple (with cable car), Sirubari Village, and Panchase Hill.
Best hotels in Syangja include Manakamana View Hotel, Syangja Guest House, Sirubari Homestay, and Panchase Lodge.
Must-try food in Syangja includes Dal Bhat, Momo, Gurung cuisine, and local Newari dishes.
Syangja is accessible by bus from Kathmandu or Pokhara (5-6 hours) or taxi. Local transport includes walking, taxis, and local buses.
